scheme_name: e-Shram Card (National Database of Unorganised Workers)
eligibility_text: Any unorganised-sector worker aged 16-59 (gig/platform workers, migrant workers, domestic workers, street vendors, construction workers, etc.) who is not an EPFO/ESIC member and not an income-tax payer. Needs Aadhaar linked to a mobile number.
benefits: Free registration; issues a lifetime 12-digit Universal Account Number (UAN); acts as the gateway that many other central schemes (PMSBY accident cover, PM-SYM pension) check against. Free 10-minute self-registration.
source_note: Verified Sep 2026. This is the identity layer most other schemes key off — a good first question to ask a user in the demo.
